Master of Applied Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering

Program type: thesis-based research degree. Length: normally two years of full-time study.

Program requirements: 4.0 credits plus a thesis. Milestones: research proposal by month 8; thesis defence by month 24.

Admission: four-year bachelor degree in a related discipline with a minimum B+ standing in the final two years. English language requirements are listed on the English language requirements page.

Supervision: a supervisor is confirmed after an offer of admission.
